title: UC00230_Urban_Flood_Risk_Prediction_Using_Spatiotemopral_Deep_Learning
author: Hariprasath Mahalingam
description: This project develops a spatiotemporal deep learning model to predict daily flood risk across Melbourne's CBD at a 1km grid resolution. By combining the city's physical infrastructure data (stormwater pits, drainage pipes, road surfaces, buildings, and tree canopies) with daily rainfall observations from the Bureau of Meteorology, the model learns how vulnerability and weather interact in space and time. A ConvLSTM neural network is trained alongside a logistic regression baseline to produce per-cell flood probability maps, and the workflow is packaged into a real-time prediction pipeline and an interactive HTML dashboard for non-technical stakeholders.
